{{Otheruses|Bureau Chief}}
'''Bureau Chief''' was a rank used by the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] to signify the commanding [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of SIS operations on a given [[Planet/Legends|planet]] or bureau. The Bureau Chief ranked above [[Special Agent/Legends|Special Agents]] and [[Agent/Legends|Agent]].
